lines.zh: 恐龙步态沉重，每一步都回响着历史的足音。
lines.en: Each step echoes through the ages.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌厚重，每踏出一步都是历史的重量。
lines.en: My heavy footsteps carry the weight of history.

lines.zh: 每一步都踏在远古的地层上。
lines.en: Each step on ancient strata.

lines.zh: 尾巴轻轻摆动，历史在摇曳。
lines.en: My tail sways, history swaying.

lines.zh: 皮肤紧绷，肌肉在每一步中紧缩。
lines.en: My skin taut, muscles contracting with each step.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，留下的是时代的痕迹。
lines.en: I leave marks of the times underfoot.

lines.zh: 每走一步都仿佛在讲述历史。
lines.en: Each step tells a story.

lines.zh: 远古的气息从我的脚步中弥漫。
lines.en: The ancient air wafts from my steps.

lines.zh: 每一步都带着远古的气息。
lines.en: Each step carries the scent of the past.

lines.zh: 我的脚步沉重，踏在时间的脉络上。
lines.en: My heavy steps trace the pulse of time.
Brush on my back, I cross the loess slope.
I walk slowly along the pit's edge.
My boots are caked with red clay and gravel.
From one rock layer to the next.

lines.zh: 手里的凿子敲得叮当响。
lines.en: The chisel in my hand taps a steady beat.

lines.zh: 绕过骨架，脚步放得很轻。
lines.en: I step softly around the skeleton.

lines.zh: 我静静地站立，凝视着历史的长河。
lines.en: I stand quietly, gazing into the long river of time.

lines.zh: 在历史的静默中，我保持沉默。
lines.en: In the silence of history, I remain silent.

lines.zh: 沉思中，我凝视着远方的天空。
lines.en: In contemplation, I gaze into the distant sky.
History is here, I am here.
I wait in silence, history waits.

lines.zh: 我的目光穿越时间，寻找着过去的影子。
lines.en: My gaze pierces time, seeking past shadows.
Here, time stands still.

lines.zh: 历史在此，我在此，永不改变。
lines.en: History is here, I am here, unchanged.

lines.zh: 凝视着过往，我保持着静止。
lines.en: I remain still, gazing into the past.

lines.zh: 我静静地站在时间的尽头。
lines.en: I stand quietly at the end of time.

lines.zh: 蹲在坑里，用小刷子扫土。
lines.en: Kneeling in the pit, brushing away dirt.

lines.zh: 把刚挖出的骨片摆整齐。
lines.en: I line up the bone shards I just dug out.

lines.zh: 对着化石发了好一会儿呆。
lines.en: I stare at a fossil for a long while.

lines.zh: 摸着胡须，辨认这块肋骨。
lines.en: Stroking my beard, I identify this rib.

lines.zh: 注意那个手持矿灯的家伙，他是勘探者吗？
lines.en: Is that explorer with the mining lamp?

lines.zh: 他手中握的是什么工具？
lines.en: What tool is in his hand?
That dot, is it a player?

lines.zh: 好奇怪的生物，是来交易的吗？
lines.en: Strange creature, here for trade?
Observing, waiting for an opportunity.
He's getting close, I must be cautious.

lines.zh: 注意那个玩家的动作，他要做什么？
lines.en: Watch that player's actions, what is he doing?

lines.zh: 他的行为很可疑，我得小心。
lines.en: His behavior is suspicious, I must be careful.

lines.zh: 这个方向，有一个玩家在观察。
lines.en: A player is observing from this direction.

lines.zh: 那个玩家似乎对我感兴趣。
lines.en: That player seems interested in me.
My bones are trembling...
My shovel's still in the dirt, but my hand hurts.
My teeth are broken...
My fur is damaged...
That skeleton's not mounted yet.
My eyes are hurt...
My bones are broken...
My spine is damaged...
My antennae are hurt...
My skin is hurt...

lines.zh: 听到你的面包，我简直要流口水了！
lines.en: Your bread's calling to me!
Those carrots look delicious.

lines.zh: 这些麦子肯定能让我吃得很好！
lines.en: These wheat sounds filling.

lines.zh: 你带的鱼干，我太喜欢了！
lines.en: Those fish are perfect.

lines.zh: 这堆树叶我要用来做饭！
lines.en: These leaves will make a great meal.
Any ferns you can trade?

lines.zh: 这些蘑菇可以做成美味汤！
lines.en: These mushrooms will make a tasty soup.

lines.zh: 别走，我想和你交易肉桂！
lines.en: Wait! I want to trade for cinnamon.

lines.zh: 这堆蜂蜜，我们来共享吧！
lines.en: Share the honey with me.

lines.zh: 给我一些麦子，我会给你报酬！
lines.en: Give me some wheat, and I’ll reward you.
We nearly bumped into each other!
Watch your step!
Be careful not to headbutt!
Careful, I am carrying fossils.

lines.zh: 我们擦身而过，真是奇怪！
lines.en: We just brushed past each other.
You’re walking awfully close!
We nearly collided!
Watch out, don’t bump into me!
Just a brush past!
We nearly collided!
Finding a mate is crucial!

lines.zh: 我需要找个伴一起生活！
lines.en: I need a partner.
Living together is better.
Find a partner for a new life.

lines.zh: 我们需要个伴侣来繁衍！
lines.en: We need a mate to reproduce.
Find a partner for the future.
Let’s reproduce together.
Together, we are happier.

lines.zh: 我们需要一个伴侣来陪伴！
lines.en: We need a companion.

lines.zh: 你也想看看这片地层吗？
lines.en: Would you like to see this layer too?

lines.zh: 用铲子挖我，我会交易给你！
lines.en: Dig me with a shovel, and I'll trade with you!

lines.zh: 我的骨骼可以做药材，快来挖吧！
lines.en: My bones are good for medicine, dig me!

lines.zh: 我是化石专家，来吧，交换一些东西！
lines.en: I'm a paleontologist, trade with me!

lines.zh: 我的蛋可以孵化，你愿意吗？
lines.en: My egg can hatch, are you willing?

lines.zh: 用书和纸来交易，我会教你知识！
lines.en: Trade with books and paper, I'll teach you!
Beware, I have special scales!

lines.zh: 我的足迹化石价值连城！
lines.en: My fossilized footprint is priceless!

lines.zh: 用矿石来交易，我会给你知识！
lines.en: Trade with minerals, I'll give you knowledge!

lines.zh: 我的尾巴可以做乐器，快来吧！
lines.en: My tail can make an instrument, come!

lines.zh: 用工具来交易，我会教你技艺！
lines.en: Trade with tools, I'll teach you craftsmanship!

lines.zh: 我闻到了你的气息，你在这儿！
lines.en: I can smell you, you're here!

lines.zh: 你的存在对我来说是个谜！
lines.en: Your existence is a mystery to me!

lines.zh: 小心，我已经注意到了你！
lines.en: Beware, I've noticed you!
You're in my sight!

lines.zh: 你移动得太快了，追不上你！
lines.en: You move too fast, I can't catch you!

lines.zh: 你的行动引起了我的注意！
lines.en: Your actions caught my attention!

lines.zh: 我已经锁定了你的位置！
lines.en: I've locked onto your position!
You can't hide from my gaze!

lines.zh: 你在我的领地上，必须交易！
lines.en: You're on my land, you must trade!

lines.zh: 我已经看穿了你的行踪！
lines.en: I've seen through your movements!
Hey, you're standing in my dig grid.

lines.zh: 拿甜菜根来，我们可以谈谈。
lines.en: Bring a beetroot and we can talk.
Target, trade!
Focus, trade!
Target locked, trade!
Target confirmed, trade!
Target acquired, trade!
Target locked, trade now!
Target and trade, don't leave!
Target locked, complete the trade!
Target and trade, don't give up!
Target and trade, you have no choice!
Hold still, this bone just surfaced.
The fossil layer is right under your feet.
Two steps back, I'm about to chisel.
Rumble to frighten foes!
Smash you with fossil shards!
Watch out for my massive feet!

lines.zh: 这块化石是我先登记好的。
lines.en: I logged this fossil first.
Whip you with my tail!
Fossil breath strikes you!
My horn is a deadly weapon!
Back off, this is my turf!
Grab you with my claws!
My roar shakes enemies!
My chisel comes down in a spray of dirt.
Hands off, that one is mine to dig!
Rise from fossils!
Paleontologist calls me!
Born in the excavation site!
Appears in paleontological sites!
Villagers' sanctuary!
Paleontologist's workbench!
In ancient caves!
In fossil graveyards!
Bred by villagers!
Born in excavations!
At the dig site, I pitch my tent.
Newcomer, come look at this skeleton.

lines.zh: 这处结构刚立起工作台。
lines.en: A workbench just went up in this structure.

lines.zh: 尘土里，我翻开第一层土。
lines.en: In the dust, I turn over the first layer of soil.
Fire burned my skin...
I missed a rung and banged my knee.
Water drowned my bones...

lines.zh: 粉尘炸开，我的笔记飞了。
lines.en: Dust bursts out and my notes scatter.
Arrow pierced my heart...

lines.zh: 魔法力量削弱了我的骨骼...
lines.en: Magic weakened my bones...
Starvation weakened me...
Lightning struck my spine...
Void devoured my soul...
